articles.title: Minskad försäljning för Ikea
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Minskad försäljning för Ikea
articles.body_text: Ikeas varuhus vid Kungens kurva strax utanför Stockholm. Arkivbild. Ikeas försäljning fortsätter att backa. För tredje året i rad sjunker den globala försäljningen för möbelföretaget. Sammantaget minskade försäljningen globalt med nästan en miljard euro till 43,8 miljarder euro under räkenskapsåret 2025/2026, som avslutades den sista augusti, skriver en rad medier, bland annat Dagens industri och Financial Times. Procentuellt handlar det om en nedgång på 1,8 procent. Det har varit ett utmanande år för oss, det är möjligt att det kommer bli så här även i år, det är inte en enkel marknad, säger Jakub Jankowski, vd för Inter Ikea, till Financial Times. För att vända utvecklingen har Ikea lanserat prisnedskärningar på en rad olika produkter som till exempel Billy-bokhyllan. Bolaget genomför också ett omfattande sparprogram där flera hundra tjänster ska bort.

articles.title: Tiktok riskerar böter för ”kaninhål”
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Tiktok riskerar böter för ”kaninhål”
articles.body_text: Tiktok utreds av EU, som vill få stopp på flöden av potentiellt skadligt innehåll i rekommendationer till användarna. Arkivbild. Kinesiska Tiktok riskerar en ny omgång EU-böter. Det sociala nätverket anklagas för att använda så kallade ”kaninhål” i sina algoritmer för att ta fram rekommendationer till användarna om vad de ska titta på. EU eskalerar en treårig utredning mot Tiktok, med ägaren Bytedance, eftersom man funnit att användare matas med filmsnuttar om ämnen de tidigare har tittat på – även om det handlat om problem med mental hälsa eller potentiellt skadlig kroppsfixering, enligt ett preliminärt utlåtande från EU-kommissionen. Kommissionen rekommenderar att Tiktok ändrar funktionen ”För dig”. ”Upprepad exponering för sådant innehåll kan få allvarliga negativa konsekvenser för användarnas välbefinnande, däribland ökad nedstämdhet eller ångest, missnöje med kroppen, sämre självkänsla eller en försämring av befintliga ätstörningar och psykiska tillstånd”, skriver EU-kommissionen.

articles.title: Fransk fregattaffär ger miljardorder till Saab
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Fransk fregattaffär ger miljardorder till Saab
articles.body_text: Saab ska utrusta fyra franskbyggda så kallade FDI-fregatter till Sverige med eldledningssystem och sensorer. Arkivbild Fransk fregattaffär ger miljardorder till Saab Försvarskoncernen Saab har fått i uppdrag av franska Naval Group att utrusta fyra nya så kallade FDI-fregatter till Sverige med eldledningssystem och sensorer, enligt ett pressmeddelande. Ordervärdet uppgår till cirka två miljarder kronor, enligt Saab, och leveranserna ska ske 2027–2034. ”Sverige får avancerade och integrerade förmågor att upptäcka, avskräcka och hantera hot både över och under vattenytan, samtidigt som marinen effektivt kan möta nya asymmetriska hot till sjöss”, säger Mats Wicksell, chef för Saabs affärsområde Naval.

articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Handelsbanken höjer bolåneräntan
articles.body_text: Handelsbanken har släppt delårssiffror. Arkivbild. Efter Riksbankens räntehöjning tidigare i veckan följer nu Handelsbanken efter och höjer listräntan för bolån med tre månaders bindningstid. Den nya listräntan ligger på 4,19 procent, uppger Handelsbanken i ett pressmeddelanden. Banken justerar även räntorna på flera sparkonton. Sedan tidigare har bland annat Swedbank genomfört samma förändring.

articles.title: AI-frossa smittar av sig – nedåt i Stockholm
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: AI-frossa smittar av sig – nedåt i Stockholm
articles.body_text: Avvaktande terminshandel på börsen. Arkivbild AI-frossa smittar av sig – nedåt i Stockholm Stockholmsbörsen faller på bred front i fredagens handel, i linje med ledande Europabörser. Nedgången följer på börsras på Wall Street i torsdags och stora börsfall i Asien under nattens handel. OMXS-index ligger vid tolvtiden på minus 1,3 procent. Bland indextungviktarna i Stockholm hittar man läkemedelstillverkaren Astra Zeneca och klädkedjan H&M, som tappar 3,8 respektive 3,1 procent. Nedgången följer på en tillfällig topp på historiskt höga nivåer för OMXS-index i torsdags. Det pekar mot en viss återhämtning både för det breda S&P500-index och på Nasdaqbörsen i terminshandeln inför veckans sista handelsdag. Torsdagens börsras i USA – det värsta sedan april 2025 – hänger ihop med oro för bakslag för AI-sektorn efter Demokratiska partiets framgångar i mellanårsvalet tidigare i veckan.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.body_text: Publicerades: Tor 29 okt 02:00 Tor 29 okt • 7 min För första gången backade Sverigedemokraterna i ett riksdagsval. articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
articles.summary: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.
articles.body_text: Tesla will wind down production of its Cybertruck vehicles at its Texas factory next year, Elon Musk says. He did not spell out whether it plans to stop making them entirely or shift production elsewhere, but did say the decision was to "make room" for building more of its self-driving Cybercab cars. But the project's lead engineer, Wes Morrill, appeared to suggest the vehicle was being discontinued, writing on X: "Cybertruck was an incredible technology development platform and lives on through Cybercab." With its distinctive angular looks, the Cybertruck attracted diehard fans, but was beset by delays before being launched in 2023 and has had disappointing sales numbers since. Tesla fans have been mourning the news online, with one person calling it " the best vehicle Tesla has ever made " as he lamented it being "discontinued next year". Musk responded to the user with the word "true", adding: "But the Cybertruck fleet will be around for a long time." The vehicle has always been a passion project for Musk. He said it was " way more awesome than people realise " in March, and called it the " best product Tesla has ever made to date " in April. But there have always been big questions about whether consumers shared that view and whether the Cybertruck could cut through and earn a spot in the US' lucrative truck market. It was not helped by inauspicious introduction to the public in 2019 when Musk attempted to show off the Cybertruck's apparently unbreakable glass, only for it to shatter during a live demonstration. Despite the gaffe, the Cybertruck ended up receiving a 146,000 orders, Musk said in 2019 , while it was still in development. In the end, the vehicle launched in 2023, keeping its novel design - an angular shape with a body made of stainless steel. Tesla fans praised its retro-futuristic look, which some said looked like something " straight out of Blade Runner ".

articles.title: Tundu Lissu: Tanzania opposition leader found guilty of incitement but acquitted of treason
articles.summary: The 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, says the charges are politically motivated.
articles.body_text: Tanzania's main opposition leader, Tundu Lissu, has been found guilty of inciting unrest and sentenced to four years in jail, in a case that has raised concerns about political freedom in the East African country. A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam acquitted him of the more serious offence of treason, saying prosecutors had failed to prove a key element of that charge. But they said the 58-year-old, who has been detained since April last year, had encouraged his supporters to disrupt the disputed 2025 general election. Lissu, who leads the opposition Chadema party, has denied the charges, describing the prosecution as politically motivated. The court said his campaign slogan "No Reforms, No Election" was sufficient for him to be convicted of the charge of incitement. "By uttering those words with the intention of disseminating them to the public, the accused incited the public to disrupt the 2025 elections," the court ruled. Lissu said he had only been charged with treason, not incitement. "The offense of incitement is one that you, honourable judges, have manufactured. You have created an offense that did not exist, and you have done so on political directives," Lissu told the court. He added that he would like to apply for bail as this was possible for incitement, unlike treason. He has leave to appeal at the Court of Appeal - the country's highest court. Treason is among Tanzania's most serious offences and can carry the death penalty. President Samia Suluhu Hassan won the October 2025 election with 98% of the vote - a result the opposition dismissed the result as a "mockery" of democracy as her two main challengers, including Lissu, were excluded.

articles.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
articles.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.
articles.body_text: One child and one young adult have died after a bus crashed in eastern France, local authorities have said. The bus was travelling between Lyon and Bourg-en-Bresse when it crashed at around 07:00 local time on Friday in the town of Lent, around 34 miles (55km) from the border with Switzerland. The town's mayor Yves Cristin told French media the bus "left the road and hit a tree in the ditch". The bus was carrying 43 passengers, including 15 children, the Bourg-en-Bresse prosecutor's office said. Three people are in a critical condition and a further 13 have sustained minor injuries. A young girl and an 18-year-old man have been identified as the two who died in the incident by authorities. However, there have been differing reports as to the age of the girl. The prosecutor's office said it was "opening an investigation into the incident, on charges of road homicide and aggravated road traffic injuries". The driver has been taken to hospital after sustaining injuries and has not yet been questioned by police, the prosecutor's office added. Photos circulating in French media show a blue and white bus tilted in what appears to be a ditch on the roadside. Trees line the side of the road. The front of the bus appears to be heavily damaged. Local mayor Cristin told BFM TV: "I arrived minutes after the accident and people were in shock. "The side of the bus was torn off, and clearly, the people who were on that side must have been seriously injured." Addressing weather conditions at the time of the crash, the mayor told Le Figaro "there was a bit of fog, the road was wet" but there were "no major difficulties". Speaking to the same paper, Fabrice Pannekoucke, head of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, said: "At this stage, there are no particular explanations or interpretations that can be given."

articles.title: Shakahola deaths: Kenya court doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie sentenced to 200 years in prison
articles.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".
articles.body_text: A Kenyan court has sentenced the leader of a doomsday cult, Paul Mackenzie, to 200 years in prison for murdering 191 people, all but one of them children. Alongside 27 others, Mackenzie was found guilty of the murders for instructing members of his cult to starve their children to death so they could "meet Jesus". Justice Diana Mochache said Mackenzie bore the "primary criminal culpability" for ordering his followers to fast to death, in one of Kenya's deadliest episodes of religious extremism. "The sentence is appropriate and just, to send an unmistakable message that such atrocities warrant the maximum penalties allowed by law," the judge added. The self-styled pastor was arrested in 2023 after the discovery of more than 400 bodies in shallow graves in Shakahola forest near the Kenyan coast. The sprawling investigation into the cases shocked Kenya and drew international attention. Ahead of sentencing, prosecutors in the court in Mombasa had argued for the death penalty for Mackenzie because of the gravity of the crimes. Capital punishment has not been carried out in Kenya since 1987. The prosecutors also cited what they described as Mackenzie's lack of remorse for the crimes. They requested life sentences for his co-accused. Before the hearing began on Friday morning, Francis Wanje, who lost eight relatives in Shakahola forest, including two grandchildren, told the BBC's Newsday programme that he was "hoping for... a sentence which will match his [Mackenzie's] deeds in the forest". Mackenzie and the co-accused have formally pleaded for mercy and asked for leniency from the court. Before their conviction on 19 October, they had all pleaded not guilty and repeatedly insisted that nobody was forced to die. Mackenzie's followers believed he was "Jesus's mouthpiece", Justice Diana Mochache said as she delivered her eight-hour judgement last month. Those who opposed Mackenzie's teachings were beaten to death.

articles.title: Somalia's Supreme court rejects President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension
articles.summary: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.
articles.body_text: Somalia's Supreme Court has ruled that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud unlawfully extended his term, escalating a political crisis and a standoff between the presidency and judiciary. Thursday's ruling came a day after Mohamud dismissed Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed - a move which the court said the president lacked the authority to take. The court also ordered political leaders to agree on an electoral plan within 30 days and hold elections within 90 days, potentially disrupting government plans for nationwide polls next year. Mohamud's four-year mandate expired in May, but his administration extended it by a year through law changes approved by parliament in March. Opposition groups accuse him of using the constitutional changes to prolong his rule. But the president insists the reforms are necessary to move Somalia towards fully democratic elections, replacing the clan-based system in which elders pick their representatives. Somalia last held nationwide direct elections in 1969 and has been wracked by civil war for more than 30 years, with Islamist militant group al-Shabab controlling many rural areas. On Thursday, the Supreme Court ruled that the constitutional changes could not be applied retrospectively to the president's current term. In a separate decision, the court declared the chief justice's dismissal "null and void", accusing the presidency of interfering with judicial independence. The president appointed Ibrahim Idle Suleiman, who previously held the position, to replace Ahmed. The presidency said the dismissal followed complaints about the administration of justice and was intended to achieve a just and transparent judiciary. But the court rejected that explanation, insisting that the chief justice could only be removed through established constitutional procedures.

articles.title: Major construction near Iran bases, satellite images suggest
articles.summary: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.
articles.body_text: Iran appears to be undertaking significant new construction near at least two of its major missile sites and repairing bases damaged by months of US and Israeli air strikes, analysis of satellite images suggests. Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November at the Garmdareh military base in Karaj near the capital Tehran and the Shahroud base in the north, analysts at British intelligence company MAIAR, who reviewed the photos, told BBC Verify. At least 12 other military sites, including missile complexes and air bases, appear to show signs of repairs. New roofs have been built on destroyed buildings at the Kermanshah missile base in western Iran, near the border with Iraq, while damaged buildings and debris have been cleared at the Parchin military complex - which has been repeatedly repaired despite a succession of air strikes - east of the capital. The excavations near Shahroud could potentially be related to the production of missiles, said Jim Lamson, a former CIA analyst who focused on Iran. He said that because the nearby air base at Shahroud has been targeted multiple times in recent years, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) is probably trying to find ways to move its production facilities underground. A MAIAR analyst said that Iran has "a pattern of moving infrastructure underground to protect them from further strikes". Mark Mellett, a defence analyst and former head of the Irish military, said the construction of underground facilities had the added benefit of making it "harder for outside observers to assess the extent and operational status". Speculation has mounted in recent weeks that the US could resume attacks on Iran after the midterm elections held earlier this week. But on Wednesday Vice-President JD Vance cited the war's unpopularity with voters for the Republicans' poor performance in this week's poll, saying that it may have cost his party control of the Senate "for the next 6 years". At multiple bases across the country, Iranian forces have focused on carrying-out small-scale repairs to complexes which have been heavily damaged by air strikes since the start of the US-Israeli war. Analysts said that satellite images appear to show that significant construction has been completed at the Taleghan 2 facility at the Parchin military complex, with damaged buildings levelled and the aftermath of attacks on an underground bunker repaired and reinforced with concrete. At Karaj and Shahroud, satellite images appear to show significant excavation. At Karaj, multiple vehicles were visible in satellite images, while improvements appear to have been carried out to the nearby airbase. The images from Karaj appear to show "a new portal for an underground facility", said Sam Lair, research analyst at the Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI), which has looked extensively into recent developments at Iranian sites. Analysis from Janes also indicates there appears to be a new facility under construction at Karaj, including tunnel entrances and structures which could indicate an expansion of nearby damaged or destroyed missile bases - or could also be for storage or other purposes. The construction work is unlikely to be part of an effort to deceive foreign intelligence agencies, said Janes analyst Sean O'Connor. He said such a project "would be costly and may achieve little".

articles.title: White House denies Hegseth, Rubio will leave jobs amid Republican election fallout
articles.summary: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Marco Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.
articles.body_text: The White House has denied rumours that Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio might leave their jobs in a post-election shakeup of the Trump administration. US media have reported there are calls to replace Hegseth - in particular over his handling of the Iran war, which is being blamed for heavy Republican election losses. One outgoing congressional Republican has threatened to force an impeachment vote against Hegseth as early as next week. The defence secretary posted a video statement defending his record and denouncing the effort. "You see, they attack me. They attack us because we are effective," he said. "It's not going to work. We will not back down." Meanwhile, Rubio is denying reports he is considering leaving his post ahead of a 2028 presidential run. Working for Trump until the end of his term has "always been my plan," Rubio told The New York Times in an interview. "I love the work I'm doing," Rubio said. "And plus I always laugh when they say he's going to leave his job. I go, 'Which one?'" The White House and US State Department also shut down reports that Rubio might be leaving after this week's midterm losses, with both calling it "fake news". The defence secretary, though, faces a more uncertain political future. Trump and Vice-President JD Vance have both blamed the Iran war for Republican losses that allowed Democrats full control of the US House of Representatives and the Senate. In a telephone interview with ABC News, Trump said that he had received "calls about" Hegseth, but added that he had "every intention" of keeping him. Later on Thursday, he told reporters at the White House that "Pete Hegseth has done a fantastic job", and went on to list what he sees are some of his achievements, including the arrest of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro in January and the Iran war, now into its ninth month.

articles.title: Trump signs order to preserve Oval Office as national monument
articles.summary: The order comes after Trump made a series of big changes to the decor of the Oval Office and tore down the White House East Wing.
articles.body_text: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order that he says will prevent future presidents from making certain changes to the White House Oval Office. The executive order declares the president's official office, which he has renovated, to be a national monument. "We're making it a national monument, and it will not be allowed to be touched by anybody, destroyed, ripped down by stupid people, in order to build something in a slightly different shape," Trump told reporters on Thursday. The order does not prevent future presidents from changing the decor of the famous room. The document says that it does not "restrict the President's authority to redecorate the monument, select furnishings, or make ordinary operational and security modifications that do not substantially impair the monument's historic structure or architectural character". American presidents currently have the power to make some changes to the White House but large projects require the permission of Congress. The order comes months after Trump tore down the entirety of the White House East Wing in a project that has faced legal challenges. The project was not approved by the US Congress. Construction has continued, with plans to turn the space into a new ballroom. Signing the new executive order on Thursday, the president said: "We like the Oval Office, and it's a symbol, like the White House itself. It's a symbol of our country and the greatness of our country." He added that world leaders who have visited in recent months have complimented his decorative changes to the room. Trump said the White House and the Oval Office had been in need of repairs before his changes, calling it "badly damaged". He described broken windows, cracked walls and broken stone. Many of the noticeable changes, though, were cosmetic, including a large gold plaque reading "Oval Office" outside the space, paving over the Rose Garden and adding a new helicopter pad.

articles.title: Pope Leo heads to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
articles.summary: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.
articles.body_text: Pope Leo XIV is beginning a lengthy trip to Latin America just three weeks after surgery for lung cancer - a tour that includes a much-anticipated "homecoming" to Peru where he was a priest for many years. The Vatican says no extraordinary measures are being taken in relation to the Pope's health, describing him as a "71-year-old who has undergone an operation" not someone with a "permanent medical condition". It was Leo himself who revealed last month that doctors had discovered a tumour during a routine scan. The growth was removed along with the lower lobe of his right lung and his medical team then confirmed the cancer had not spread. At a briefing in Rome ahead of the trip, which takes in Uruguay and Argentina as well as Peru, a spokeswoman stressed that Pope Leo had "fantastic stamina" and was "extremely enthusiastic" about the schedule which he had "personally confirmed... with no changes". "The Vatican's message with this trip is, 'that was a short episode and now we're back on track'," Professor Massimo Faggioli of Villanova University told the BBC, pointing out that the Pope has had a busy return to work since his surgery. "We have seen him in these last few days making speeches, audiences and so on. He seems in great shape. That was important." The 12-day tour would be demanding for anyone, though. It incorporates multiple long-haul and local flights and covers thousands of miles from the Amazon to the Andes. The starting point will be Uruguay, where the number of Catholics has fallen away steeply in recent years and which is getting its first Papal visit in four decades. Leo then heads for Argentina, homeland of Pope Francis, his predecessor. "This visit is also a homage to Francis, who didn't make it to Argentina [as pope]," says Father Fernando Laguna, the rector of Santa Maria Addolorata, Argentina's national church in Rome. "When this visit by Pope Leo was announced, it filled all of our hearts with joy," he told the BBC. "I always thought he would go, despite his illness. I don't think he ever thought of calling it off!" The priest is installing a big screen inside the church in Rome to allow parishioners to follow all the key moments of the trip from afar. The building is already decked out with posters declaring Pope Leo is welcome in Argentina. "We're waiting for you!", one proclaims.

articles.title: Will Nigeria's Atiku Abubakar be on the presidential ballot after ADC court ruling?
articles.summary: The high court has sacked the leadership of the opposition ADC party with only months to go until elections.
articles.body_text: Nigeria's Federal High Court has sacked the leadership of the opposition African Democratic Congress (ADC) party - and also ruled that the nomination of its presidential candidate, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, is invalid. A statement from the ADC said the ruling was another desperate attempt to cripple the opposition. Presidential elections are scheduled to take place on 16 January when President Bola Tinubu's main challengers are again expected to be Abubakar and former Anambra State Governor Peter Obi. Several high-profile politicians joined the ADC in 2025 - disillusioned by the factional infighting in the once powerful Peoples Democratic Party (PDP). Among them were Abubakar - who had served as vice-president between 1999 and 2007 when the PDP was in power - and former Senate president David Mark. As accommodations were made for the line-up of political heavyweights, Mark took over as its interim chairman. But Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former ADC national deputy chairman, argued before the court that this was not lawful as Mark and others had not been elected at a national convention. Instead, he said, he himself should have taken over the party's leadership following the resignation of the ADC's former chairman in 2025. This is not first time the Federal High Court in the capital, Abuja, has ruled on the leadership of the party. In July, judge Musa Liman said Mark had been chosen in accordance with the country's laws and the party's constitution - in a case brought by another former ADC member. Abubakar said the latest case raised serious legal concerns: "Why, after that judgment, was another case filed to reopen the same dispute?" In a statement, the ADC added that Thursday's judgement by Justice Peter Lifu was aimed at stifling the opposition momentum and "was a calculated attempt to weaken the ADC and frustrate" Abubakar's candidacy.

articles.title: California Governor Gavin Newsom commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
articles.summary: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.
articles.body_text: California Governor Gavin Newsom has commuted the death sentences of all 548 people on death row in the state, changing them instead to life in prison. "We can now let these offenders die in obscurity while we forever remember and honour the victims," he said in a letter. The decision to spare death row inmates is largely symbolic in a state that has not executed an inmate since 2006, though experts say it could save millions of dollars in court costs each year. Only 13 inmates have been executed since voters reinstated the death penalty in 1978. The decision comes as Newsom, the Democratic leader of the most populous US state, has been discussed as a possible 2028 contender for president. Newsom, who is term limited, is winding down his final months in office. Fellow Democrat Xavier Becerra is projected to take over after the midterm elections on Tuesday. Newsom explained in his letter that he is exercising his constitutional clemency authority to commute the sentences to life without the possibility of parole. "After nearly 30 years in public office, I have come to understand the limits of what government can justly accomplish," Newsom said. "I take this action because I firmly believe that state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with California's values, undermines the foundations of our legal system and diminishes each of us". California has historically had the largest population of death row inmates. Newsom had previously ordered a halt to the death penalty in the state in 2019. Describing his decision as a difficult but "righteous action", Newsom said that although many Californians feel that those who commit brutal crimes deserve to die, he has concluded that "the state cannot morally kill them". He said that by every measure, California's system for administering the death penalty "is a failure", and that it has not and cannot be fairly applied, resulting in the conviction of innocent people. Life without the possibility of parole is the most severe punishment he can lawfully impose and that the state can ethically enforce, he said. He acknowledged that his clemency action will anger and hurt some Californians and said that it will "always weigh heavily on me".

articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, organizada por la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.title: Últimos feriados 2026 en el Perú: ¿Cuántos feriados hay en noviembre y diciembre?

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, organizada por la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, organizada por la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.title: Fenómeno de El Niño alcanza al mango, ¿cuál es el panorama de los otros productos de la agroexportación?
articles.summary: El ministro recordó que en octubre de este año se aprobó un paquete para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño y los choques externos por S/18.000 millones y S/2.000 millones en otros 15 dispositivos.
articles.body_text: Las lluvias en el norte del país y las altas temperaturas están afectando a las principales frutas de exportación como el mango, confirmó el ministro de Comercio Exterior y Turismo (Mincetur), Rogers Martin Valencia. “El mango está bastante afectado. Tengo entendido que no ha habido floración. Del limón todavía no tenemos data”, explicó el ministro. Por el momento, mencionó Valencia, no se cuenta con estadísticas sobre a cuánto ascienden las pérdidas o el número de hectáreas comprometidas o en riesgo ante el fenómeno de El Niño. Según la agencia Agraria de Noticias, la Asociación Peruana de Productores y Exportadores de Mango (APEM) proyecta que las exportaciones peruanas de esta fruta fresca alcanzarían las 135.182 toneladas, representando una contracción de 39,57% frente a las 223.686 toneladas despachadas en la campaña anterior (2025/2026). En contraste, el ministro detalló que se ha logrado completar la última parte de la cosecha de uva para exportación y la carga fue embarcada sin contratiempso. “Si bien se anunciaron lluvias la semana pasada en Piura, finalmente no se registraron lluvias”, explicó. Durante la XX Cumbre Internacional de Comercio Exterior: “Cómo mantener operativo el Comercio Exterior peruano durante el fenómeno de El Niño”, organizada por la Cámara de Comercio de Lima (CCL), el ministro recordó que existe un paquete económico e instrumentos de protección diseñados para brindar certidumbre financiera y proteger a los productores y asegurar la continuidad de sus actividades. Para ello se aprobaron S/18.000 millones en aras de amortiguar los efectos directos del fenómeno de El Niño y S/2.000 millones para respaldar y financiar programas de seguros productivos y agrícolas; además de otros apoyos para el sector pesquero como la suspensión temporal del pago de cuotas de créditos otorgados a través del Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Pesquero (Fondepes), entre otros. “Después del fenómeno hay que pensar en qué hacemos. Y eso se refleja en la articulación y la difusión de mecanismos de financiamiento de seguros, de garantías y de fondos no reembolsables, para reactivar al sector otra vez”, mencionó. De otro lado, resaltó la implementación de secuencias de cabotaje marítimo que se ha organizado para permitir el transporte de los alimentos en distintas rutas como entre los terminales de Pisco - Callao - Paita o los de Paita - Chancay - Paita, entre otros, y así evitar el desabastecimiento. “La idea es que no nos quedemos desconectados”, agregó.

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. Si quieres saber cuándo será el próximo feriado y qué fechas aún quedan por disfrutar este año, aquí te contamos todos los detalles. Los feriados son fechas establecidas por ley en las que los trabajadores tienen derecho a suspender sus labores sin que ello afecte su remuneración. Durante estas jornadas, el descanso es obligatorio tanto para el sector público como para el privado, salvo en aquellas actividades que, por su naturaleza, deben continuar operando. Si un trabajador presta servicios durante un feriado y no recibe un día de descanso compensatorio, la legislación laboral establece que le corresponde una remuneración adicional por haber laborado en esa fecha, conforme a las disposiciones vigentes. A diferencia del feriado, el día no laborable no constituye un descanso obligatorio para todos los trabajadores. Generalmente, esta medida se aplica al sector público con el objetivo de extender periodos de descanso o promover actividades como el turismo interno. En el caso de las entidades públicas, las horas que no se trabajan deben recuperarse posteriormente, dentro del plazo fijado por la normativa o según lo disponga cada institución. Para el sector privado, la aplicación de un día no laborable depende de un acuerdo entre empleador y trabajadores. Si no existe consenso sobre la recuperación de las horas, será el empleador quien determine la forma en que estas deberán compensarse.

articles.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027 | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.
articles.body_text: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck next year, according to CEO Elon Musk, who said on X that the company will use the factory space to build more two-seater Cybercab robotaxis. The decision to wind down the futuristic, steel-clad EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. When Musk handed over the first few Cybertrucks in late 2023, he predicted Tesla would sell around 250,000 per year. It was supposed to be such a cornerstone of Tesla’s future that, before construction began, the company talked about its Texas factory as the “Cybertruck factory.” But Tesla has instead sold just tens of thousands — total — over the last three years. Tesla is killing off the Cybertruck at a moment when it is trying to become an AI- and robotics-focused company. A big part of that is its robotaxi ambitions. The company has spent the last two months putting Cybercabs on the streets in its hometown of Austin, Texas. With no major incidents to date, the company has said it plans to expand the Cybercabs operations to other cities, starting with Dallas later this month. (Tesla also operates robotaxi versions of its Model Y SUVs in Austin, Houston, and Dallas, as well as three cities in Florida.) This is the third product Tesla has discontinued in order to fuel those greater ambitions. Earlier this year, the company decided to end production of the Model S sedan and Model X SUV and instead use the factory space dedicated to those vehicles to make Optimus humanoid robots. First announced in 2019, the Cybertruck was a product that Musk had long obsessed over. “Probably my personal favorite for the next product is the pickup truck, and we are going to just do an amazing pickup truck,” he said on one of Tesla’s earnings calls that year. Musk promised the Cybertruck would be radical, inspired by the designs of cyberpunk sci-fi stories like Blade Runner . While that certainly bore out in the design, the company overpromised on the basics of the Cybertruck from the jump. During the now-infamous reveal event in 2019, when head designer Franz von Holzhausen cracked the Cybertruck’s windows with steel balls, Tesla said the EV was supposed to start at under $40,000 and have up to 500 miles of range. It achieved neither of those figures. Instead, the truck was delayed for two years, in part because of the Covid-19 pandemic. When it finally did hit the market in late 2023, Tesla handed over the first few Cybertrucks to customers in a short, somewhat odd for Tesla event (by the company’s own standards, at least), which saw a poorly-lit Musk standing in a truck bed promising the truck was “the finest in apocalyptic equipment” fit for “late civilization vibes.” The base price had inflated to around $60,000, and the top-end range had shrunk by over 100 miles. The truck has struggled on the market ever since. The polarizing design never seemed to sit well with buyers, especially at a higher-than-expected price. Then, during its first full year of sales in 2024, Musk became a major financial backer of Donald Trump, which turned the instantly recognizable Cybertruck into a target for protesters. That continued into 2025 as Musk led the so-called Department of Government Efficiency, which fired thousands of federal workers. articles.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.
articles.body_text: Flock, founded in 2017, sells surveillance software — like license plate readers, drones, and microphone-based edge-computing devices to pick up gunshots and other sounds — that can help solve crimes, such as finding missing people or stolen cars. More than 100,000 Flock cameras are in use nationwide. But in the past three months, Monroe , Ohio; Newburgh , New York; Richmond , Virginia; Hopkinton, Massachusetts; New Bedford , Massachusetts; and Lansing , Michigan, have all moved to end their contracts with Flock. Meanwhile, police in East Bridgewater and Grafton, Massachusetts, also announced plans to stop using Flock cameras. Just this week, residents of League City, Texas, voted against their police department’s continued use of Flock’s license plate readers, and the cameras are now set to be removed. In Asheville, North Carolina, police lost access to Flock after the city voted to terminate its contract in August, and the El Paso County Sheriff’s Office in Colorado announced in September that it would stop using Flock cameras. When asked for comment, the El Paso County Sheriff’s Office redirected TechCrunch to its press release, where Sheriff Joseph Roybal said that discontinuing the use of Flock was the right decision for the county. “We have the tools, training, and experience to locate and apprehend criminals without relying on Flock cameras,” he said in the press release. Misuse has been a real problem. In August, for example, an officer in Brentwood, Missouri was accused of using Flock cameras to stalk his ex-wife during their divorce. In September, an officer from East Texas was sentenced to prison for using Flock to stalk his ex-girlfriend and her family. Another growing concern is how immigration officials have been able to access the technology. One case that captures the issue came in March, when Ithaca, New York, passed a resolution to terminate its contract with the Flock Group. In the resolution, the city said there were “proven instances of Flock Safety infrastructure being used by federal agents for information purposes even without specific authorizations from the contracting locality,” and that the city had reviewed reports that “either intentionally or through its negligence,” Flock had allowed U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) to “use query results from its database of state and local ALPR [automatic license plate reader] data to investigate and persecute immigrants throughout the United States.” “Every day, police departments across the country are using Flock technology to solve serious crimes, locate suspects, find missing people, and make a measurable impact on public safety,” Flock told TechCrunch in a statement. “While we respect every community’s decision, removing a tool that is actively helping solve violent crimes and protect communities moves public safety backward. Every Flock customer owns its data and controls who it is shared with and how it can be used. Flock does not sell data and does not have a contract with ICE.” This August, Flock announced it would shorten the default period it stores data for new customers, from 30 days to seven. It also said agencies now need a case code before they can search the database. That lack of awareness is similar to how data centers are popping up across the country, often before residents understand what is happening. Schwartz said police departments often decide to use Flock on their own, with little oversight from city councils. In South Windsor , Connecticut, according to local reports, Flock cameras went live last year without public warning or a vote. In October, the town voted to remove its Flock cameras. “Grassroots activists across the country have been demanding that city councils exercise their procurement power to refuse to pay for ALPRs,” Schwartz said, referring to councils’ power to decide what the city buys. He added that activists have been fighting for years and that “many city councils are listening.” The main argument for technology like Flock is that it helps combat crime and keep neighborhoods safe. And many local governments are not dropping Flock or similar technology; instead, they are adding restrictions on its use or looking for alternatives.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.
articles.body_text: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security , a startup that secures AI agents’ access to company systems, for $500 million in cash plus additional milestone-based payouts, according to a person familiar with the discussions. Three-year-old Clutch was last valued at $85 million when it raised a $20 million Series A round in January 2025, led by Lightspeed and SignalFire, according to our source. The startup is currently approaching $10 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). That means the acquisition, if completed, would value Clutch at about 50 times its ARR, a standard way of pricing software companies. Palo Alto Networks and Clutch Security did not respond to a request for comment. The Information was the first to report the acquisition discussions. The high valuation is not an anomaly in a market increasingly focused on securing software against bad actors using AI to breach systems more easily. Upwind, a startup using AI to secure cloud infrastructure, recently turned down an acquisition offer from DataDog that valued it at roughly 40 times ARR, TechCrunch reported last week. If the deal happens, it would be Palo Alto Networks’ seventh acquisition this year, according to PitchBook. The cybersecurity giant has a history of buying innovation rather than building it in-house, and it has ramped up dealmaking this year in response to rising AI-driven cyberattacks. In September, Palo Alto Networks acquired Console, a two-year-old startup that uses AI agents to automate routine IT help desk tasks. The transaction valued Console at $500 million in stock and cash, TechCrunch reported. Other VC-backed companies that Palo Alto Networks has scooped up this year include NEA-backed Embrace, for $325 million ; Chronosphere, an observability platform backed by Greylock and Lux Capital, for $2.95 billion ; and Koi, a cyber startup backed by Battery and Team8, for $231 million , according to regulatory filings. Several of Clutch’s competitors have also been acquired. Cyera, a cybersecurity startup valued at $12 billion earlier this year, acquired Oasis Security, which, like Clutch, focuses on managing AI agents’ access to systems, for $1 billion . Meanwhile, Cisco bought Menlo Ventures-backed Astrix for roughly $400 million , Calcalist reported. When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.
articles.body_text: The New York Times Company has reportedly “entered exclusive negotiations” to acquire Letterboxd for $330 million, according to a report from The New York Times itself. Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers that could be compared to Goodreads for movies, has grown dramatically in recent years. Letterboxd reported 3 million users in January 2021, a figure that grew to 28 million by April of this year. More than half of its users are under 35. Letterboxd was previously reported to be seeking a new owner. According to the Times, film studios A24 and Sony were interested in the acquisition, but A24 was priced out. Letterboxd is free, but users can access advanced features with a paid subscription. Its projected earnings for this year are estimated at $15 million, which is only about 4.5% of what the Times is supposedly offering to buy the company for. The New York Times Company declined to comment on the acquisition to its own paper (lol). Personally, we wouldn’t be surprised if these anonymous tips were coming from inside the house, so we’re inclined to take this report pretty seriously. articles.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law | TechCrunch
articles.summary: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.
articles.body_text: Meta, Google, and TikTok have each filed lawsuits against California Attorney General Rob Bonta in an attempt to block a law that restricts social media features it deems addictive for users under 16. California Governor Gavin Newsom signed the bill, known as AB 1709 , into law in September, and it’s slated to take effect at the start of the new year. The law prohibits social platforms from offering autoplay videos and personalized feeds to users under 16, and it requires the platforms to delete these users’ accounts if they don’t turn those features off. If platforms do not comply, they could be liable for fines of up to $50,000 per affected user under 16 years old. Meta claims that AB 1709 violates the First Amendment by overriding its editorial decisions about how to display content, adding that Section 230 preempts the law. TikTok and Google made similar arguments. “Meta currently organizes its feeds of content to include personalized content recommendations and to automatically play media, [so] the Act would make it unlawful for Meta to disseminate speech to minors altogether, and would require Meta to delete minors’ accounts, unless it changes these practices,” the company wrote in its lawsuit. In an emailed statement, a TikTok spokesperson added, “AB 1709 is a blatantly unconstitutional restriction on free expression that erodes the long-standing and protected practice of curating content based on user preferences, which book stores, TV networks and streaming services all use.” Alajaji added that teenagers’ use of social media has been instrumental in enabling impactful digital activism, citing the Parkland shooting survivors’ March for Our Lives and climate activist Greta Thunberg’s global reach. “As a functional ban on social media for youth under 16, AB 1709 cuts young people off from essential information and experiences, silencing the very voices it claims to protect,” Alajaji said. These platforms are primed to fight this California law as they navigate similar legal battles in various countries. That’s especially true for Meta, which agreed to pay a settlement of up to $18 billion to resolve children’s safety claims brought by 29 U.S. states. In December 2025, Australia became the first country to ban social media for users under 16 altogether. France passed a similar law, but its top court struck it down , citing concerns about violations of free expression rights. These platforms also argue that the law would affect parents’ ability to make decisions about their teens’ internet use through parental controls. A Google spokesperson noted that autoplay on YouTube is turned off for minors by default, and that parents have the ability to turn off their teens’ access to Shorts altogether.

articles.title: Airbnb says it's launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
articles.body_text: Airbnb has teased its plans to build its own AI travel agent before, but on Thursday the company announced that the new AI feature will launch in the first half of 2027. In the company’s Q3 shareholder letter on Thursday , Airbnb also provided more detail about how the agent will work, what it will actually do, and how it’s different from a typical AI chatbot. In prior interviews, CEO Brian Chesky sketched out the travel company’s approach to AI, describing a plan to build an AI agent that has a richer interface than a conventional chatbot. He also expressed his opinions about how chatbots aren’t the right interface for travel, noting that people take pleasure in the planning process and in anticipating a trip. Any agent that it built, then, shouldn’t take away from the inspiration and the browsing, he told TechCrunch in an interview last month. Chesky today reiterated that belief, telling analysts on the earnings call that people won’t use one AI agent for everything. “Today’s AI agents like Muse and Instinct are good at simple routine tasks like making a restaurant reservation or scheduling an appointment. But planning a trip is different,” he said. “Travel is aspirational. Discovering where to go and where to stay is part of the experience. In fact, 80% of travelers say they enjoy spending time researching trips. People want to look at photos. They want to compare homes. They want to make decisions with people they’re traveling with,” he continued. “And I don’t think the general-purpose agents are the best to do that. So that is why we are building our own AI agent,” Chesky said. Airbnb described its agent as having a personalized interface that’s designed specifically for travel, where it will “build an interface” around a user’s question instead of simply responding as a chatbot would. “What we are doing is developing a custom-designed AI-native experience that responds to what guests are looking for,” Chesky said. “So instead of relying on traditional chat alone, which is very text-heavy — which, again, is definitely not the way you should plan travel, our agent draws from a library of hundreds of travel-specific interface components — maps, photos, comparisons, calendars, itineraries — and composes them in real time to match what they’re looking for.” The exec said the agent will feel “a little bit like generative UI” as it’s designed to offer up “the right interface at the right time” for someone’s specific travel needs. In its shareholder letter, the company touted that its nearly 20 years of experience in bringing hosts and guests together is informing how the agent is built, as it incorporates insights about how people both book and host on its platform. The agent will also be able to help travelers beyond the booking itself. “Our agent will be able to help guests throughout their trip — from changing a reservation or resolving a payment issue to getting help with refunds, rebooking, or 24-hour safety support. These are things an outside agent can’t easily do on its own,” the company wrote. Over time, Airbnb expects the agent will be able to help travelers with other aspects of their trip, including not only homes and hotels, but also services and experiences. Services and experiences are two areas that have become a bigger focus for the company following its redesign last year. While the company previously said to expect its AI agent sometime in the next year, it’s now more specifically committing to roll out the new technology to consumers in the first half of 2027. The news of the agent’s release was delivered alongside strong third-quarter earnings, with revenue growing 19% to $4.87 billion, topping Wall Street estimates. It also raised its 2026 revenue growth forecast, which it now predicts will be in the high teens, instead of the mid-teens.

articles.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Serve Robotics announced alonsgside its third-quarter earnings that it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services to offer customers its connectivity and data tools.
articles.body_text: Serve Robotics , a maker of self-driving sidewalk delivery robots, is expanding beyond its autonomous delivery operations in a bid to become a technology supplier to other companies building robots. The company, which spun out of Uber’s acquisition of Postmates in 2021 and went public in 2024, said Thursday it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services. Specifically, Serve Robotics will offer customers its connectivity and data tools. Bedrock Robotics, a startup developing self-driving systems for construction equipment, is a customer, according to Serve. It’s also working with T-Mobile to bring AI computing power closer to robots, Serve announced alongside its third-quarter earnings on Thursday. “We are solving the problem of robots in human spaces,” Serve Robotics CEO and co-founder Ali Kashani told TechCrunch. Serve Robotics already makes two kinds of robots, the cute googly-eyed sidewalk delivery robot and one designed for hospitals that it got through its acquisition of Diligent Robotics . Those businesses are not going away, Kashani emphasized in a recent interview. Instead, he said there is opportunity to sell the technology it developed for its own robots to other companies developing robots for farms, warehouses, and other uncontrolled environments. “I kind of think of it as the AWS moment where we are taking the technology we’ve built for us, and we’re opening it up for more people to build on,” he said, adding this wouldn’t have been possible without developing its own robot fleet. The expansion comes as Serve’s sidewalk delivery business expands, but is shifting away from Uber and toward other partners, including DoorDash and Wonder. Its new Physical AI Services business line will offer three products. Serve Link helps connect robots in the field to AI systems running in data centers, which would allow companies to potentially tap into more powerful AI models without having to put all that computing power onboard. “Any robotic application generally needs to connect the robots to some offline intelligence, whether it’s to collect data or do exception handling or whatever,” said Kashani. “It’s the connectivity piece that has to be really high performance. You need to be able to manage really unreliable networks and still reliably connect, and that’s what we solve.” It’s also launching a data curator tool that helps companies find edge cases in the reams of real-world data a robot collects, which can then be fed back into a training model to improve performance. Its third product is a real-world, foundation-model data catalog built from Serve’s own sidewalk robots that can teach AI models how to understand complex human environments. Kashani said he’s been thinking about this idea — a playbook he learned from Amazon — for years.

articles.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
articles.body_text: Muse Voice, a feature that lets users call and video chat with Meta’s consumer AI agent, Muse, is now available to everyone in the U.S., the company announced on Thursday. First introduced at Meta’s Connect developer conference in September, the video-chatting feature involves new AI models, Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice technology, which help power the digital avatar that chats with the user. While other AI competitors offer voice chat features, Meta’s Muse offers a cute, animated avatar (nicknamed Jolly), which users interact with as they ask questions or request tasks to be handled on their behalf. Users can also customize the avatar as they choose, changing it to something that looks more like a person, animal, or some other character. The company believes that anthropomorphizing Muse in this way could make consumers feel more connected to their AI agent — a connection that could grow even stronger as they begin to engage in live conversations with it. As the Muse avatar speaks, Meta says it will use “subtle expressions and gestures” that match the tone of the conversation. (Muse doesn’t actually “see” the user, but it hears them and reacts based on their conversations.) The news of the rollout was announced via blog post and on X by Meta’s chief AI officer, Alexandr Wang, who shared a demo of his Muse in action. The video saw Wang joking around, referencing his love of posting memes on X, which he told his Muse may have gotten him in trouble with his boss. His Muse, a fluffy white dog, responds with a suggestion to add disclaimers to those memes that could be misinterpreted as Meta endorsing anything risqué. (Ha!) The added support for video chats and calls comes just before Meta’s plan to launch a Tamagotchi-like wearable device for its Muse AI agent before year-end. When the device arrives, the digital avatar will appear on its small screen, letting users talk to the agent, which can then reply or carry out tasks for them. Meta says the real-time conversations are supported on mobile, web, and Mac and will later come to its AI Glasses and the upcoming “Muse Charm” hardware device.
